business_problem: NetEase Fuxi needed a way to move beyond rigid scripted NPC dialogue and support richer real-time interaction for a massive player base without sacrificing world consistency or service stability.
solution_summary: NetEase Fuxi and Baidu AI Cloud brought ERNIE large-model capabilities into the mobile game Justice to create an in-game AI arena populated by interactive NPCs. The solution uses Qianfan AppBuilder and Qianfan ModelBuilder to provide the application and model layer behind AI characters that can answer free-form player questions, stay aligned with their gender, profession, age, geography, and life history, and respond in ways that fit the open-world setting. ERNIE-Character-Fiction-8K is optimized for space-time and scenario consistency so characters can push storylines forward instead of repeating canned scripts. The same platform supports dynamic scene dialogue, broad topic coverage, and real-time interaction at massive scale, while Baidu's infrastructure provides enough concurrency headroom to handle the QPS demands of a title with more than 100 million active players.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Organizes the in-game AI interaction flows and application logic for NPC conversations.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the model-development layer used to adapt ERNIE capabilities for game NPC behavior.

solution_components.name: ERNIE-Character-Fiction-8K
solution_components.role: Drives real-time character dialogue, scenario consistency, and dynamic story progression for AI NPCs.

data_flow: Player prompts and world context enter the Qianfan-backed NPC system, where the character model interprets context, generates in-character responses, and feeds the interaction back into the live game session. Infrastructure capacity keeps those flows stable even under very high concurrent traffic.
business_outcome: NetEase Fuxi delivered a more dynamic game world, expanded what players can ask and do with NPCs, and proved that large-model characters can operate at massive consumer scale.
metrics: Justice has more than 100 million active players.
architecture_clues: The deployment uses a character-specialized ERNIE model optimized for scenario and world consistency
NPCs can handle free-form questions rather than only preset dialogue branches
Baidu provided resource guarantees for high-QPS game traffic
evidence_quotes: NetEase Fuxi and Baidu AI Cloud used ERNIE large models to build the world's first in-game AI arena for Justice and deliver real-time intelligent NPC interaction (original: 网易伏羲联合百度智能云，基于文心大模型打造全球首个游戏AI竞技场，为《逆水寒》上亿玩家提供智能NPC实时交互体验).

Traditional NPCs are limited by predefined text, whereas the intelligent-agent approach gives every NPC more realistic personality and thought (original: 传统NPC受限于规定剧情文本的局限性…智能体最大的意义，莫过于赋予每个NPC独一无二的思想、性格).

The ERNIE character model can cover diverse settings and make stories develop more dynamically while keeping characters believable and fun (original: 文心人设大模型（ERNIE-Character-Fiction-8K）时空和场景优化能力…模型能够理解上下文，并主动推动多样化剧情发展).

Justice has more than 100 million active players and Baidu provided the resource guarantees needed to handle possible QPS challenges smoothly (original: 目前，逆水寒端手游活跃玩家总数已超过1亿，百度智能云提供了充沛的资源保障，以应对游戏可能遇到的QPS等高并发挑战).
